# Chrome Gotchas

> Known Google Chrome / Chromium patterns that cause silent failures or hard-to-debug errors.

## Entries

- [Pending Chrome update stalls service-worker apps (OWA) while other sites load fine](pending-update-relaunch.md): Chrome swaps its binaries on auto-update while still running, so until relaunch it cannot spawn service workers and OWA hangs on skeleton placeholders with no error, reading as a network/DNS/M365 fault. Check for two version folders and new_chrome.exe first, and cross-test in another browser. HIGH.
- [Headless Edge print-to-PDF follows the OS dark theme](headless-edge-print-to-pdf-follows-the-os-dark-theme.md): msedge --headless --print-to-pdf (and headless Chrome) evaluates prefers-color-scheme from the Windows theme, so on a dark-theme machine every PDF prints with the dark palette -- valid PDF, exit 0, correct on a light-themed PC. Scope dark overrides to screen (@media screen and (prefers-color-scheme: dark)) or force light in @media print; also print with a throwaway --user-data-dir so the user's open Edge is untouched, and note headless Edge's minimum window width is 496 px. HIGH.
